question: Map the frozen a1=1,a2=0 universal-matter U1 variables to the physical metric seen by baryons/photons and determine whether the completed linear scalar system can be identified directly with standard CLASS Newtonian-gauge metric sources.

primary_sources.paper: K. Lin, S. Mukohyama, A. Wang, T. Zhu, arXiv:1310.6666v4
T. Zhu, F.-W. Shu, Q. Wu, A. Wang, arXiv:1110.5106v2

acceptance: derive tilde_N=N-A+mathcalA, tilde_N^i=N^i+N g^ij nabla_j varphi and tilde_g_ij=g_ij on a1=1,a2=0
show that in quasilongitudinal U1 gauge delta_varphi=0 the physical lapse is tilde_N=N-A and the physical shift scalar equals bare B
show at linear order that the general physical shift scalar is B_phys=B+delta_varphi/a and is invariant under the local U1 transformation delta B=alpha/a, delta varphi=-alpha

show that the allowed scalar spatial FDiff leaves the physical shear combination Sigma_phys=B_phys-E_prime invariant, so after fixing E=0 there is no remaining k>0 scalar spatial gauge freedom to set B_phys=0 unless Sigma_phys vanishes dynamically

use flat k=0, Lambda_g=0 background equations to show A_hat drops out of the background dynamical equation; record A_hat=0 as an admissible production-matching branch choice, not as a forced equation or a second gauge fixing
on A_hat=0 branch derive Phi_matter=phi-deltaA/a, Psi_matter=psi and B_matter=B in quasilongitudinal gauge

conclude that direct identification with standard CLASS Newtonian gauge B=E=0 is not justified unless the reduced dynamics separately implies Sigma_phys=0; otherwise a shear-aware/gauge-invariant Boltzmann bridge is mandatory

decision.if_pass: Do not patch the completed metric solver directly into CLASS newtonian phi/psi variables. Next derive either gauge-invariant photon/baryon source combinations in the preferred foliation or an explicit shear-aware CLASS metric layer.
decision.if_fail: Revisit the universal matter-frame mapping before any completed-action CLASS work.

non_claims: not a no-go for CLASS or Boltzmann implementation
not a claim that physical shear is observationally large
not a completed photon or baryon hierarchy
not an exact k=0 perturbation gauge statement
